title: An Approximate Solution to the Minimum Vertex Cover Problem: The Salvador Algorithm
summary: Minimum Vertex Cover has a classical linear-time ratio of $2$, and under the Unique Games Conjecture no polynomial-time algorithm achieves a fixed ratio below $2$ unless $\mathrm{P}=\mathrm{NP}$. We present version 0.1.4 of \textsc{Salvador}, a linear-time ensemble of seventeen strategies, numbered in the order in which they are computed: twelve base strategies (component amplification before a maximal matching, the maximal matching itself, degree and weight heuristics, reductions to auxiliary problems that are solved exactly, a decomposition into bipartite layers, a weighted subdivision…
